newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ median house prices rose in Sept - REINZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ median house prices rose in Sept - REINZ.

text.p: The national median price for a New Zealand house rose to NZ$153,000 in September from $147,000 in August and $141,000 a year earlier, the Real Estate Institute of New Zealand (REINZ) said on Thursday.
REINZ said residential property continued to recover from a winter downturn, with nationwide sales increasing for the second month in a row.
Dwelling sales in September totalled 6,600, up 137 over the previous month.

REINZ Vice President Max Oliver predicted a continued firming market in line with previous seasonal trends, adding he could not recall a time when the market had been so buoyant just prior to an election.
Sales in the Auckland region rose over the month but the median price of NZ$220,000 remained the same when compared with August, but was up from $190,000 in September 1995.
In Metropolitan Auckland the median was NZ$225,000.
